historical_growth.growth_rate_source: base-case FY2026-FY2030 geometric average revenue growth (10/5/4/3/2), anchored to FY2026 guidance and the Actemra-then-Hemlibra biosimilar sequence; the backward equity 5yr CAGR (15.6%) is rejected as a forward proxy because it embeds the FY2021-22 Ronapreve/COVID windfall and the Hemlibra ramp from launch.
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 5yr CAGR 15.6% diverges >30% from revenue 5yr CAGR 9.8% (ratio 1.59) and from revenue 3yr CAGR -0.1%: equity compounded through retained Ronapreve-era profits and a rising royalty mix while revenue has been flat since FY2022 (1,260bn -> 1,258bn). Flagged; equity CAGR not used for projection.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs are on the owner-FCF series (reported FCF - SBC - interest income): FY2020 143,221 -> FY2022 172,248 -> FY2025 270,590. Owner and reported FCF CAGRs differ by <0.5pp because SBC is ~0.04% of revenue; the only material adjustment is interest income, which grew from 100m to 3,600m as the cash pile and JPY rates rose. Note FY2025 owner FCF (21.5% of revenue) is depressed versus FY2024 (33.6%) by a 191bn cash-tax catch-up and 112bn capex; neither margin is carried forward.

scenario_narratives.base: Chugai remains Roche's antibody-engineering hub with a growing royalty stream but loses its two largest legacy franchises in sequence: Actemra to biosimilars from 2026 and Hemlibra from ~2030. Revenue grows ~10% in FY2026 on royalties and new launches, decelerates to low single digits through 2030, dips ~2% across the Hemlibra cliff and resumes 2-2.5% growth as NXT007, RG6640 and the TOP I 2030 launch cadence partly refill the portfolio. EBITDA margin eases from ~51% to 45% as the highest-margin income erodes while R&D is maintained at ~14% of revenue. Capex normalises from the Utsunomiya peak to 4.5%.
scenario_narratives.bull: Royalty income compounds at 20%+ for several more years (Hemlibra, NEMLUVIO, Enspryng label expansions), NXT007 succeeds Hemlibra before the cliff, RG6640 gives Chugai a Roche-commercialised obesity product, and the yen stays weak; growth stays at 3%+ into the terminal period with margins held at 50-52% on royalty mix.
scenario_narratives.bear: Actemra erosion is fast, NHI cuts and a stronger yen compress both domestic and translated revenue, Hemlibra biosimilars land on the 2029-30 exclusivity expiry, and Roche's unilateral program decisions plus pipeline attrition leave no replacement of scale; revenue falls ~15% peak-to-trough over FY2030-33 and margin compresses to 38%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Chugai is valued as a going-concern antibody R&D engine whose economics are a declining-then-refilling sequence of franchises rather than a steady compounder, so the explicit horizon is run through the Hemlibra cliff before capitalising a 45% margin at 18x owner FCF. Flows are IFRS, SBC-expensed (immaterial), lease-charged (treatment B) and ex interest income, with the company's own 869bn net-cash definition (cash + marketable securities, no debt, leases excluded) added in the bridge. Risk is charged in the flows and the 25/50/25 weights, not in the discount rate, which is a single JPY cost of equity of 7% across scenarios. The current price (~23x FY2026 Core EPS, ~27x year-1 owner FCF ex cash) sits above the weighted intrinsic value; the market is paying for the pipeline and Roche's commercial reach at a level the house method only reaches in the bull case.
key_risks_to_valuation: Hemlibra biosimilar timing: the base fades revenue over FY2031-33; if US exclusivity (~2029) is enforced to the ~2032 composition patents and bispecific manufacturing deters entrants, the cliff shifts right and the base is ~10% too low; if entry is on the 2029 date the bear path applies
Roche alliance: overseas revenue and royalties depend on Roche's commercial and portfolio decisions; a change in the alliance terms or a Roche buy-in/sell-down is outside the three scenarios
FX: ~56% of sales plus royalty income are USD/EUR/CHF-linked; a 10% yen appreciation is worth roughly 5-6% of revenue and more of margin, and the FY2026 guidance assumes 151/USD
Japan NHI pricing: now annual revisions; the FY2026 revision was poorly received by industry and a steeper regime would hit the domestic 44% of sales directly
Terminal multiple: the 18x cap binds in every scenario (Gordon at 7%/2% is 20.4x), so the valuation is sensitive to the cap, not to terminal growth; at 15x the base falls materially
Pipeline binary risk in both directions: NXT007, RG6640, RG6160 and Enspryng expansions are the swing factors between bear and bull
Working-capital and cash-tax timing: FY2025 showed a 29% FCF drop on receivables and a tax catch-up; the model uses a 30% cash rate and -25% capture, both of which can be off by a year

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 5,974-10,700
data_sources.financials: 4519.T_Metrics.csv (core_metrics, IFRS, FY2016-FY2025 annual plus quarterlies to 9M FY2026); FY2025 annual report (kessan tanshin, English) for cash-flow component lines, lease payments, ROU depreciation and diluted share count; 9M FY2026 tanshin for the 2026-09-30 balance sheet
data_sources.qualitative: 4519.T_Analysis.json (2026-10-31): segment mix, Roche alliance, Actemra/Hemlibra biosimilar timeline, NHI pricing, FY2026 guidance and pipeline events

inputs.cash_composition: Cash and cash equivalents 382,305 + marketable securities 486,690 at 2026-09-30 (9M FY2026 balance sheet). This is the company's own net-cash definition (FY2025 annual: 'net cash, including marketable securities and interest-bearing debt' = 979.7bn = 426.6 + 553.1). Lease liabilities are excluded from net debt because the lease charge is deducted in the flows (treatment B). Non-current 'other non-current assets' (73bn, includes investment securities and pension surplus) are NOT added to the bridge; no dividend income is stripped from the flows, so the matching-asset rule holds.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow statement share-based payment add-back (483m); EquityAwardTaxes 0 every year (Japanese filer, no net-share settlement withholding). SBC is immaterial (<0.05% of revenue) but kept as an explicit line.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest received 3,599m FY2025 (annual report line 1513); stripped because net cash (869bn) is >3x the owner-FCF base. 9M FY2026 run-rate is ~6.7bn/yr as JPY rates rise; the stripped figure only affects the FY0 anchor, not the projection.
inputs.buyback_note: Repurchases are odd-lot only (5-30m/yr); H1 FY2026 shows a one-off 3,932m. Chugai returns cash via dividends (~45% Core payout, 299bn in FY2025 incl. a 150/share 100th-anniversary special). Flat share count is a modelling convention that SBC of 0.04% of revenue makes essentially free.
inputs.share_count_basis: Diluted weighted-average shares 1,645,661,614 (FY2025 annual report line 1449; no dilutive instruments eliminated); 9M FY2026 derived 1,645.6m. Held FLAT: SBC is fully expensed in the flows. Roche holds 59.89% of shares outstanding.
inputs.wacc_rationale: JPY-denominated flows discounted at a JPY-built cost of equity: 10y JGB ~1.7% + beta 0.9 x Japan ERP 5.9% = ~7.0%. Zero debt, so WACC = cost of equity. Beta is held at 0.9 (observed equity beta ~0.7 for a thin-float Roche subsidiary) so that a single rate is used across all three scenarios; pipeline, biosimilar and NHI-pricing risk is charged in the scenario flows and weights, not stacked on the discount rate. House reference ~9% for JPY keiretsu industrials; a non-cyclical net-cash pharma sits below that.
inputs.lease_treatment: B: leases as operating cost. Lease principal (8,176m) + interest paid (429m) in FY2025 = ~0.7% of revenue is deducted inside EBITDA via lease_cost_pct_path; lease liabilities are excluded from net debt. D&A for the cash-tax EBIT is ex right-of-use depreciation (32,535 - 5,999 = 26,536m = 2.1% of revenue) so the lease is charged once. Capex is PPE + intangibles only (leases sit in financing).
inputs.nci_treatment: None material: dividends to non-controlling shareholders ceased after FY2018 and the 9M FY2026 balance sheet shows total equity entirely attributable to Chugai shareholders. No deduction.
inputs.notes: Model: owner-FCF component DCF (SKILL.md routing row 'operating company, non-US'), 10-year explicit horizon because the Hemlibra patent cliff (US BPCIA exclusivity ~2029, composition-of-matter patents ~2032) is a known-date event inside the horizon that a 5-year build would capitalise before it lands. IFRS figures are used throughout (EBITDA = IFRS operating profit + D&A; FY2025 598,833 + 32,535 = 631,368 = 50.2% margin), not Chugai's 'Core' basis; the Core-to-IFRS gap is ~17bn of intangible amortisation and one-offs. FY0 = FY2025 (calendar 2025); year 1 = FY2026, which is 10 months old at valuation. 9M FY2026 revenue is +17.2% YoY (1,068bn, 79% of the unchanged 1,345bn guidance) but Q3 was inflated by a one-off domestic shipment pull-forward ahead of an ERP cutover, so the base year-1 growth is set between guidance (+6.9%) and run-rate (+12%), not at either. Working-capital capture is negative (-25% of the revenue change): receivables 419bn + inventories 291bn against payables 78bn means growth consumes cash and FY2025 FCF fell 29% on rising receivables and a 191bn tax catch-up. SBC-near-zero market: house and street bases coincide to within a few yen; band_position is degenerate and should be read as n/a. Price is the Tokyo regular close of 2026-10-30; Chugai is listed only on the TSE so no parity check applies.

bear.narrative: FY2026 only meets guidance (+6.9%) as the ERP pull-forward fully reverses in Q4; Actemra biosimilars (Celltrion, Mochida/Ayumi) take share faster than Roche's export volumes can absorb; annual NHI revisions and a yen recovery toward 135/USD cut domestic and translated royalty revenue; Hemlibra biosimilars arrive on the 2029-30 US exclusivity expiry and Roche defends price, so Chugai's royalty/export stream falls 25-30% over FY2030-33; Roche discontinues further Chugai-originated programs (as with emugrobart, GYM329, RG6042) and NXT007/RG6640 disappoint, so R&D at 15%+ of a shrinking revenue base drives margin to 38%. Revenue troughs ~1,160bn in FY2033, roughly FY2024's level.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 +10%: 9M is +17.2% but Q3 carried an ERP pull-forward and management held 1,345bn (+6.9%); 10% implies a Q4 of ~316bn vs 346bn a year ago, i.e. the pull-forward reverses. FY2027-30 decelerates 5/4/3/2 as Actemra biosimilars (Japan from April 2026, exports to Roche) erode a top-four franchise and annual NHI revisions compress domestic prices, offset by Hemlibra/NEMLUVIO royalties, Lunsumio, Vabysmo, Elevidys and Enspryng label expansions (MOGAD/TED PDUFA Jan-2027). FY2031-33 (0/-2/0) is the Hemlibra cliff: US exclusivity ~2029 and composition patents ~2032 with Sandoz/mAbxience and CSPC biosimilars already in development; a bispecific is hard to copy so erosion is gradual, not a Humira-style collapse. FY2034-35 recovers to 2-2.5% on NXT007, RG6640 (GLP-1/GIP), RG6160 and the 'one global launch a year' cadence partly delivering.
base.margin_rationale: FY2026 51.5%: Core OP guidance 670bn on 1,345bn is 49.8% before ~33bn D&A; 9M IFRS OP margin 48.9% + D&A ~2.3pp. Held near 50-51% through FY2029 as royalty mix rises (high-margin, no COGS) against domestic price cuts. Fades to 45% by FY2033 as Hemlibra royalty/export income (the single highest-margin stream) erodes and R&D (190bn guided FY2026, ~14% of revenue) is held to fund replacements. 45% terminal is still above the FY2021-23 range (42-45%) and reflects the structurally higher royalty share.
base.capex_da_rationale: FY2025 capex 111.6bn (8.9%) was a peak: Utsunomiya UT3 bio-drug-substance and UTA injection buildings plus 35bn of intangibles (in-licensing incl. Renalys/sparsentan). 9M FY2026 capex 68bn implies ~7% for the year. Fades to 4.5% once the Utsunomiya/Ukima programme completes; D&A ex-ROU rises from 2.1% to 3.0% as the new plants depreciate. Terminal capex 1.5pp above D&A funds biologics capacity for the replacement portfolio.
base.tax_rationale: 30% cash rate: Japan statutory ~30.6%; FY2022-25 cash rates (taxes paid / PBT) were 28.6 / 39.7 / 18.5 / 32.0, averaging ~30%, the FY2024/25 pair being a timing swap. IFRS effective rate FY2025 27.4%. No NOL or credit to ramp from.

bull.narrative: FY2026 lands at the 9M run-rate (+12.5%, ~1,415bn) rather than guidance; royalty/profit-share income keeps compounding at 20%+ on Hemlibra, NEMLUVIO (Galderma) and Enspryng's MOGAD/TED approvals; NXT007 reads out as a Hemlibra successor so the FY2031-32 cliff is a hand-over rather than a hole; RG6640 enters the GLP-1/GIP market as a Roche-commercialised global product; yen stays weak (>=150/USD). Margin holds at 50-52% because the mix shifts further toward royalty income with no COGS.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25% because the downside is a dated, near-certain event (Hemlibra exclusivity/patent expiry, Actemra biosimilars already launched) delivered through a single commercial partner that has repeatedly discontinued Chugai programs unilaterally, and the domestic pricing headwind is government-set. Bull cut from 35% to 25% because it needs several independent outcomes (NXT007 succession, RG6640 in obesity, sustained yen weakness, continued 20%+ royalty growth) to all land. Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
